Swap Sex of Employees

https://leetcode.com/problems/swap-sex-of-employees/

Solved on 2026-10-03

## Solution

```sql
UPDATE Salary
SET sex = CASE
    WHEN sex = 'm' THEN 'f'
    ELSE 'm'
END
;
```

## Explanation

The solution is straightforward. We write an UPDATE statement that changes sex to f if it is currently m. Otherwise (which covers all cases due to the enum type described), we change f to m.
